$comment: Static, reviewed allow-list of trusted PGP signing keys. Each entry maps a signer identity to a key fingerprint and the organizational role that identity is authorized to act under. Verification is CLOSED-WORLD: a key not listed here is never trusted, regardless of keyserver or web-of-trust state. No TOFU, no dynamic key fetching.

keys.comment: Example/reviewed key for the release-signer role; the test-suite generates its own ephemeral manifest at run-time and never trusts this fixture.
